title: Ferroptosis-related genes participate in the microglia-induced neuroinflammation of spinal cord injury via NF-kappaB signaling: evidence from integrated single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analysis.
authors: Wang, Siqiao; Yang, Li; Wu, Zhourui; Li, Chen; Wang, Shaoke; Xiao, Zhihui; Ma, Bei; Zhu, Rongrong; Cheng, Liming
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞和空间转录组分析脊髓损伤中的铁死亡相关基因和神经炎症，虽涉及NF-kappaB信号和转录因子调控网络，但核心是疾病病理机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ferroptosis and immune responses are critical pathological events in spinal cord injury (SCI), whereas relative molecular and cellular mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: Micro-array datasets (GSE45006, GSE69334), RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) dataset (GSE151371), spatial transcriptome datasets (GSE214349, GSE184369), and single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets (GSE162610, GSE226286) were available from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Through weighted gene co-expression network analysis and differential expression analysis in GSE45006, we identified differentially expressed time- and immune-related genes (DETIRGs) associated with chronic SCI and differentially expressed ferroptosis- and immune-related genes (DEFIRGs), which were validated in GSE151371. Protein-protein interaction and microRNA-mRNA-transcription factor regulatory networks were constructed based on Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes (STRING) and NetworkAnalyst, respectively, which were validated by chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing (ChIP-seq). Cell subclusters and unique features of microglia in SCI were identified by single-cell transcriptomic analysis, which were validated in GSE226286. Spatial expression patterns of DETIRGs and DEFIRGs were validated in brain injury (GSE214349) and SCI (GSE184369). Potential mechanisms underlying neuronal regeneration by neurotrophin-3 (NT3)-chitosan were revealed by transcriptomic analyses in GSE69334. Immune- and ferroptosis-related mechanisms of nanolayered double hydroxide loaded with NT3 (LDH-NT3) were investigated in vivo and in vitro. RESULTS: GBP2, TEC, UNC93B1, PLXNC1, NFATC1, IL10RB, and TLR8 were DETIRGs represented chronic SCI-specific genes and peripheral blood biomarkers. NFKB1 may regulate expression of CYBB and HMOX1 in a unique subcluster of M1 microglia within the middle SCI lesion, establishing links between microglial ferroptosis and neuroinflammation. Reduced inflammatory responses and microglial ferroptosis were potential effects of NT3-chitosan or LDH-NT3 on neuronal regeneration. CONCLUSIONS: A novel subcluster of microglia exhibiting M1 polarization and ferroptosis phenotype was involved in SCI. These microglia may trigger neuroinflammation and induce neuronal degeneration within the middle site of SCI, which might be inhibited by NT3-chitosan or LDH-NT3.
abstract_zh: 背景：铁死亡（ferroptosis）和免疫反应是脊髓损伤（spinal cord injury, SCI）中的关键病理事件，而相关的分子和细胞机制仍不清楚。方法：从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库获取微阵列数据集（GSE45006、GSE69334）、RNA测序（RNA-seq）数据集（GSE151371）、空间转录组数据集（GSE214349、GSE184369）以及单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集（GSE162610、GSE226286）。通过GSE45006中的加权基因共表达网络分析和差异表达分析，我们鉴定了与慢性SCI相关的差异表达时间相关和免疫相关基因（DETIRGs）以及差异表达铁死亡相关和免疫相关基因（DEFIRGs），并在GSE151371中进行了验证。基于检索相互作用基因搜索工具（Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes, STRING）和NetworkAnalyst分别构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和microRNA-mRNA-转录因子调控网络，并通过染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）进行验证。通过单细胞转录组分析鉴定了SCI中小胶质细胞的细胞亚群和独特特征，并在GSE226286中进行了验证。DETIRGs和DEFIRGs的空间表达模式在脑损伤（GSE214349）和SCI（GSE184369）中进行了验证。通过GSE69334中的转录组分析揭示了神经营养因子-3（NT3）-壳聚糖促进神经元再生的潜在机制。在体内和体外研究了负载NT3的纳米层状双氢氧化物（LDH-NT3）的免疫和铁死亡相关机制。结果：GBP2、TEC、UNC93B1、PLXNC1、NFATC1、IL10RB和TLR8是DETIRGs，代表慢性SCI特异性基因和外周血生物标志物。NFKB1可能调控SCI中间病变内M1小胶质细胞独特亚群中CYBB和HMOX1的表达，建立了小胶质细胞铁死亡与神经炎症之间的联系。减少炎症反应和小胶质细胞铁死亡是NT3-壳聚糖或LDH-NT3对神经元再生的潜在效应。结论：一种表现出M1极化和铁死亡表型的新型小胶质细胞亚群参与SCI。这些小胶质细胞可能触发神经炎症并诱导SCI中间部位的神经元变性，而NT3-壳聚糖或LDH-NT3可能抑制这一过程。
